versions.name: Outbreak
versions.text: At the start of every even turn summon a Soul Cage. The outbreak counter starts at 4.

versions.name: Outbreak
versions.text: Turn start: If it's turn 10 or later, summon a Soul Cage and increase the counter by 1.

versions.name: Outbreak
versions.text: Turn start: If it's turn 10 or later, increase it's counter by one and summon a Soul Cage if you don't have 2 of them already.
